verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API, linked at /docs/teams-api, for automating deployment and for audit-log reporting. That is a first-party public API, but it is limited to the Teams/Enterprise tier and scoped to admin and deployment tasks rather than driving sessions or connections. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, Markdown docs or llms.txt, which weakens machine-readability but does not contradict the API's existence. missing for 10: API coverage of core remote-session control, evidence of the API reference contents, machine-readable spec (OpenAPI), availability outside paid Teams plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
